spanish: Y harás mesa de maderas de acacia; dos codos su largo, y codo su ancho, y codo y medio su alto.
grammarChanges: Translated the untranslated Hebrew form "shitím" to its Spanish equivalent "acacia" (h02025023004); common noun, not a locked proper name.
Left the supplied "de" linking "mesa" to the wood-construct phrase as is; auditor confirmed this is grammatical smoothing required by Spanish, not an added meaning.
